messages:
mia (product): Drafting a rollout for Reserved Capacity pacing + fallbacks for EU Dedicated. Need a pragmatic plan: tenant buckets, consent for cross-region, and UI visibility.
raj (eng-sre): Sounds right. Proposal: 1h rolling window with minute granularity; states green/yellow/red. Trigger fallback if red persists for 2 consecutive 5m windows.
jules (eng-platform): Implementation: per-tenant sliding counters sharded to avoid KV hot keys. Buckets: green<=70%, yellow 70-90% (notify + reduce burst), red>90% (route to local-quantized or opt-in cross-region).
lina (eng-runtime): Runtime can route to variants. Policy example: "if red and local_quant available -> local_quant; elif red and cross_region_opt_in -> eu-west-variant; else -> soft-throttle". Need feature-flag canary for policy push.
sam (sales): Customers want visibility and an emergency buy option. Add "remaining hourly budget" in console and a one-click burst purchase. Also provide notification templates for yellow/red.
ops-oncall: Ops: add circuit-breaker: sustained 5m p95 delta >150ms OR error delta >1% -> auto-revert routing + page SRE. Also add cooldown 10m after revert.
m i a (product): (typo corrected) mia (product): We'll default EU regulated tenants to local-only fallback; cross-region must be explicit opt-in with consent logs.
jules (eng-platform): Telemetry: tenant_id, bucket_state, decision, fallback_variant, reason, ts. Retention 60d; sample full traces at 1%.
raj (eng-sre): Preflight tests: simulate 2x traffic burst with mixed fallbacks to ensure no amplification and KV shard resilience. Verify rollback <3m.
ops-oncall: I will write runbook snippets and add console+email+webhook notifications for yellow/red states.
mia (product): Launch criteria: policy engine in staging, runtime routing validated, UI opt-in with audit logs, telemetry+alerts wired, legal signoff for cross-region. Canary: 5 internal tenants -> 2% -> 10% EU Dedicated. Sync tomorrow 10:30. :thumbsup:
